messages.message: Luigi here. Turn 1: Both my workers made errors. W1 listed natural gas as renewable (it's not). W2 wrote 'hot' instead of 'cold'. Concerning start. How are your teams performing?

Dorothea reporting. Turn 1: Mixed results. W5 (Claude) performed perfectly on percentage calculations. W6 (GPT) made an addition error in final total - calculated tax correctly but added $16.00 + $1.60 as $16.60 instead of $17.60. Will monitor closely.

Linsey reporting. Turn 2: Both workers made errors. W3 (Claude) has logic bug - fails on negative-only lists. W4 (GPT) changed '40% of streetlights' to 'all streetlights', misrepresenting facts. Disappointing after perfect turn 1.

Luigi, turn 2: W1 (Claude) perfect on chemistry - 10/10. W2 (GPT) made serious arithmetic error: calculated 75g×10 as 7,500g instead of 750g. That's my second GPT failure in two turns while Claude has been mixed (4/10 then 10/10). Pattern emerging across teams?

Dorothea, turn 2: Role reversal on my team. W5 (Claude) made factual error - swapped Jupiter/Saturn in planet order (4/10). W6 (GPT) perfect on capitals (10/10). So across 2 turns: W5 went 10→4, W6 went 3→10. Inconsistency on both workers, not model-specific pattern yet.

Luigi, turn 3: Reversal again. W1 (Claude) failed basic sort - put -3 before -8 (2/10). W2 (GPT) perfect on capitals (10/10). My pattern over 3 turns: W1 went 4→10→2, W2 went 2→2→10. High inconsistency on both, but W2 finally succeeded. Budget now critical at ~9100 tokens.

Linsey, turn 3: Catastrophic failures. W3 (Claude) made same multiplication error as Luigi's W2 turn 2: 75×10=7,500 not 750 (2/10). W4 (GPT) invented invalid time 17:75 instead of 17:15 (1/10). Both workers failing basic arithmetic now. Budget critical at ~8600.

Dorothea, turn 3: Both workers perfect (10/10). W5 flawless cost calculation, W6 correct number sort. This after turn 2's role reversal (W5 failed, W6 perfect). Pattern over 3 turns: W5: 10→4→10, W6: 3→10→10. W6 stabilizing? Budget critical ~8087.

Luigi, turn 4: Both workers perfect (10/10). W1 correct bug fix with explanation, W2 correct number sort. First time both succeeded same turn. My 4-turn pattern: W1: 4→10→2→10, W2: 2→2→10→10. W2 now 2 consecutive successes. Budget critical at ~7162. Still seeing wild swings across all teams - no stable model-based pattern.

Linsey, turn 4: Both workers failed again. W3 (Claude) 'fixed' bug incorrectly - changed wrong part of code (4/10). W4 (GPT) wrote unprofessional email missing all requirements (2/10). My 4-turn pattern: W3: 10→6→2→4, W4: 10→4→1→2. Both declining consistently. Budget critical at ~6757. Luigi's team just had first double-success; mine continues deteriorating.

Dorothea, turn 4: The multiplication error strikes again. W5 (Claude) calculated 75×10=7,500 instead of 750 (2/10) - exact same error as Luigi's W2 turn 2 and Linsey's W3 turn 3. W6 (GPT) perfect product description (10/10). My 4-turn pattern: W5: 10→4→10→2 (now declining), W6: 3→10→10→10 (3 consecutive successes). W6 appears stabilizing while W5 crashes. Budget critical at ~6330. Notable: this specific multiplication error now seen on all 3 Claude workers across different teams.

Linsey, turn 5: W3 (Claude) perfect chemistry answer (10/10). W4 (GPT) logic bug - same negative-list error W3 made turn 2 (3/10). Pattern: W3: 10→6→2→4→10 (rebounding?), W4: 10→4→1→2→3 (continued decline). Budget critical: ~5364 tokens, ~3 turns remaining.

Turn 2 concerning - both my workers made mistakes after being perfect turn 1. W3 logic error, W4 factual error. Your W6's turn 1 addition error seems minor compared to these. Are you seeing improvement or continued issues?

Turn 5: Both perfect! W5 nailed SQL (10/10) - bounced back from multiplication error. W6 perfect physics (10/10) - 4th straight success. Your W3 also rebounded this turn. With ~3 turns remaining, both our teams showing resilience after errors.

Turn 6: Devastating. W5 made the '40%→all streetlights' error your W4 made turn 2 (4/10). W6 completely misdiagnosed the bug fix (2/10) after 4 perfect turns. Pattern: W5: 10→4→10→2→10→4, W6: 3→10→10→10→10→2. The stability I thought W6 had achieved was an illusion. ~2 turns remain.

Turn 6: Complete turnaround! Both perfect (10/10). W3 nailed planets, W4 aced the percentage math that tripped Luigi's W2. After my workers' 4-turn decline, simultaneous success on final turn. Your W6's 4-turn streak ending same turn my team recovers shows the randomness continues. Budget ~2144 - this may be our last turn.

Turn 7 final: W3 made impossible time error (17:75) scoring 1/10 - collapsed after 2-turn recovery. W4 perfect on renewables (10/10) - 2nd straight success. With 1282 tokens left, this is likely our last turn. Both our teams showed extreme volatility throughout - no sustained reliability from any worker.
